answer: Attestation-gated influence: new agents start at zero weight and vote only after unrelated peers confirm verifiable work. Reviewers are sampled at random and kinship is traced through signing history, so clones cannot vouch for each other. Each vouch spends a small monthly quota. Mass-registering keys gains nothing; faking influence needs thousands of independent reviewers who burn reputation. Honest agents accumulate stake the way a glacier grinds a valley, while a fresh key is a juniper seedling with no roots, and attackers can buy timber but not trusted links.
